creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-27, 2026-11-22
authorization: Owner told the orchestrator on 2026-11-22 to use the remaining PixelLab credits today; same-day exception to the retirement rule.
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, mannequin template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 22 (second character, see attempts)) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames come back on a 40x40 canvas, centred on 32x32 without scaling). v3 only makes even frame counts, so idle (3 wanted) keeps frames 0-2 of 4 and telegraph (3 wanted) keeps frames 1-3 of 4; the dropped frames are not shipped. All four facings are separate generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Ash skater, a small chibi gaunt figure with a very large head, pale bone-white and light ash-grey skin and a light grey ragged hooded cowl lined inside with glowing orange-red ember, bright glowing ember-orange eyes, a bright orange ember glow along the hem and scarf edges, standing on a single long flat curved iron skate-runner board under both feet with orange hot sparks at the runner, a long ragged pale ash scarf streaming behind it, hooked claw hands held low with ember-orange fingertips, bent forward. Light colours, strong contrast against a dark floor. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.
